Text.Text: The smith-guards no longer answer to him. The forge can serve its workers again. You've finished my Absolute Defense trials. I have no further work for you here.
Your heavy-blade guard isn't ready for the forge trials. Reach rank 50 in Heavy Vibroblade, then return. A sound guard comes before a harder test.

Smith-guards have taken the Forge Caverns and are teaching a defense that serves only themselves. I want their training records back. Defeat six Absolute Defense Adepts in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Absolute Defense Forge Heat Ledger; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Sith Academy. I'll give you the Korriban Forge Caverns Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Absolute Defense.

Here's the Korriban Forge Caverns Key. Use 'Forge Caverns' in Korriban, Sith Fortress, Forgeworks. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Absolute Defense Adepts, then return with the Absolute Defense Forge Heat Ledger.

A guard that has stopped pretending. Absolute Defense is steel tempered until nothing on the far side of it matters, a wall you carry in two hands. The forge heat is the only honest test I know. Flattery melts. Excuses burn off. What's left either holds or it doesn't, and down there you'll be tested the same way the steel is.

Smith-guards. Mine, once. They swore their edges to the forge, then quenched that oath in a darker one, some Sith doctrine promising steel that never yields to anything, loyalty included. Now they hold my lower galleries and run heats I never signed. The adepts are the greenest of them. Green steel still cuts.

Every heat in a lawful forge goes in the ledger. Temperature, time, whose hands worked the metal. Forge law says the ledger is the forge, and whoever holds it answers for every blade those galleries have produced. Bring me the Forge Heat Ledger and their work becomes mine to judge again.
Defeat six Absolute Defense Adepts in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Absolute Defense Forge Heat Ledger; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Sith Academy.
You've defeated six Absolute Defense Adepts. Let me see the Absolute Defense Forge Heat Ledger.
The ledger is back where it belongs. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The ledger points to specialists using our tempering equipment. Recover their matrix before they ruin more of the forge's work. Defeat five Absolute Defense Specialists in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Absolute Defense Sith Tempering Matrix; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Sith Academy.
Your key still grants access to Korriban, Forge Caverns. Defeat five Absolute Defense Specialists to secure the Absolute Defense Sith Tempering Matrix, then return to me.

A Sith tempering matrix. It sits in the quench trough and murmurs while the steel cools, and the steel remembers what it hears. Blades that hold grudges. Edges that want. Forge law calls any unsanctioned temper a corruption of the stock, and I want that thing off my racks and cold in my hands.

The wrong fire at the wrong time, same as ruins most good steel. A Sith came down from the crypts preaching a defense that yields nothing, ever, to anyone. My smiths heard 'unbreakable' and stopped hearing anything else. Oaths are welds. Made in bad heat, they look solid right up until the day they shear.

There's one below the smith-guards call the master. I have watched his guard across three generations of steel and never once seen it passed. Not by me. Not by anyone I trained. You are not ready to talk about him, so we won't.
Defeat five Absolute Defense Specialists in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Absolute Defense Sith Tempering Matrix; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Sith Academy.
You've defeated five Absolute Defense Specialists. Let me see the Absolute Defense Sith Tempering Matrix.
This matrix will let the smiths work safely again. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden keeps the smith-guards in line. Defeating him will break their hold on the caverns. Defeat the Absolute Defense Warden in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Absolute Defense Cracked Anvil Sigil; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Sith Academy. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Korriban, Forge Caverns, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Absolute Defense Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Absolute Defense Cracked Anvil Sigil.

He kept my anvils for twenty years. Best hammer-hand I ever trained, and the first to swear the bad oath. The night the galleries turned, he cracked his own anvil to mark it and kept a shard for a sigil. Understand: he doesn't attack. He waits, and lets you break yourself against him. The patience is the lesson. It's also the trap.

In forge law, the anvil is the forge's word. Crack one, and you've broken your word to every smith who ever worked it. He wears that crack proudly, like it set him free. Bring the sigil to me and his claim on my galleries cracks with it.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Absolute Defense Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Defeat the Absolute Defense Warden in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Absolute Defense Cracked Anvil Sigil; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Sith Academy. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Absolute Defense Warden. Let me see the Absolute Defense Cracked Anvil Sigil.
His sigil confirms the warden's defeat. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

The overseer's inner circle still controls the forge's clearances. Take back their authority to order the smiths around. Defeat four members of the Absolute Defense Inner Circle in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Absolute Defense Overseer's Clearance Token; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Sith Academy.
Your key still grants access to Korriban, Forge Caverns. Defeat four members of the Absolute Defense Inner Circle to secure the Absolute Defense Overseer's Clearance Token, then return to me.

Clearance to stand the deep floor and sign heats in the forge's name. They minted their own tokens, and that's forgery under any forge law older than Korriban. One genuine token in my hand turns every blade they've signed from armament into evidence.

Now you're ready to ask, so I'll answer. He holds the innermost ring, and he holds the finished thing itself: the guard you've been bleeding toward, whole, with no flaw left in the grain. When his circle falls he will know your name without being told. He reads footwork off the stone the way I read a heat off the color of the steel.

When you first stood here, your guard dropped a finger's width on the out-breath. It doesn't anymore. That's what honest heat does. It adds nothing to the steel; it burns off everything that was never steel to begin with. What's left of you rings when it's struck. One ring remains, and it isn't yours yet.

Defeat four members of the Absolute Defense Inner Circle in Korriban, Forge Caverns. Their defeat secures the Absolute Defense Overseer's Clearance Token; bring it back to me here in Korriban, Sith Academy.
You've defeated four members of the Absolute Defense Inner Circle. Let me see the Absolute Defense Overseer's Clearance Token.
The forge's clearances are ours again. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master is the last obstacle. His guard is formidable; this is the final forge trial. Defeat the Absolute Defense Master in Korriban, Champion Forge. Report back to me here in Korriban, Sith Academy; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Korriban, Champion Forge, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Absolute Defense Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

I recommend two companions against the Absolute Defense Master. Spread the pressure so one person doesn't have to carry the whole fight. You can enter alone, but prepare carefully before you call the challenge.

Look at my hands. Forty years of hammer and tong, and they'd still hold a blade. But he was my finest work before he was my failure, and a smith who quenches the same steel twice ruins it. It has to be new hands. It has to be yours.

The oath dies with the ring. Whoever's left below comes up and answers forge law, the heats get re-signed, and Korriban keeps one forge that makes blades instead of doctrine. And you walk out carrying the only guard that matters. Yours. Finished.

Defeat the Absolute Defense Master in Korriban, Champion Forge. Report back to me here in Korriban, Sith Academy; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Absolute Defense Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The smith-guards no longer answer to him. The forge can serve its workers again. You've earned the right to train Absolute Defense. Your final payment is ready.
Another question first.
I'll defeat six Absolute Defense Adepts.
What is Absolute Defense, exactly?
Who holds these caverns?
What does this ledger prove?
Not yet. I know my flaws.
Here's the Absolute Defense Forge Heat Ledger.
I have another question.
I'll defeat five Absolute Defense Specialists.
What is this tempering matrix?
What turned your smiths?
Tell me about their master.
Not this heat. I'll be back.
Here's the Absolute Defense Sith Tempering Matrix.
One more thing before I go down.
I'll defeat the Absolute Defense Warden.
Who is this warden?
What is the sigil he wears?
Would you recommend bringing help?
My crew isn't gathered yet.
Here's the Absolute Defense Cracked Anvil Sigil.
Before I go, a question.
I'll defeat four members of the Absolute Defense Inner Circle.
What does the token clear, exactly?
I'm ready to ask about the master.
How does the steel look, overseer?
The deep floor can wait one more day.
Here's the Absolute Defense Overseer's Clearance Token.
Hold the heat. I have questions.
I'll face the Absolute Defense Master and report back.
Can his guard be passed at all?
Why send me? Why not go yourself?
And the forge, when he falls?
Not until my crew is rested.
The Absolute Defense Master is defeated. Here's my report.
